title: Metal nanoparticles in neuroinflammation: impact on microglial dynamics and CNS function
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5426-5451
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07798A, Review Article

Masood Alaei, Khadijeh Koushki, Kimia Taebi, Mahdieh Yousefi Taba, Samaneh Keshavarz Hedayati, Sanaz Keshavarz Shahbaz
Metal NPs cross BBB and release low drug doses in a time-controlled manner in the target site. AuNPs and IONPs predominantly inhibit neuroinflammation, while other metal NPs promote it. Metal NPs possess dual role in modulating microglia.
